measurements.name: Western Adriatic Current
measurements.range_interpretation: One local width reported from a mean surface-flow profile. Two locations are not a seasonal/annual interval, numerical uncertainty or confidence interval.
measurements.geographic_scope: Cross-shore mean profile off Ravenna, northwestern Adriatic; section AA-prime in Figures 13-14.
measurements.section_orientation: Source cross-shore transect; exact geographic endpoint coordinates not extracted.
measurements.layer: Radar surface flow; approximately 1 m effective measurement depth is not a fixed-depth slab.
measurements.time_convention: Deployment October 2002 to October 2004; source calls profiles two-year means. Site-specific coverage and gaps differ, with exact averaging weights and valid width timestamps unresolved.
measurements.boundary_rule: Author-reported width of mean alongshore-flow profile. Figure 15 uses coast to distance of no mean flow; no exact zero crossings or geographic edges digitized.
measurements.source_citation: Chavanne, Janekovic, Flament, Poulain, Kuzmic and Gurgel (2007), Tidal currents in the northwestern Adriatic: High-frequency radio observations and numerical model predictions, JGR 112 C03S21, doi:10.1029/2006JC003523.
measurements.source_locator: Section 5 paragraph 30, PDF6-7; Figures 13-14, PDF14; experimental setting paragraphs 8-13 and Figure 2, PDF2-3; Figure 15, PDF15.
measurements.extraction_method: Reported local mean widths transcribed from visually inspected original prose, with source profiles inspected but not digitized.
measurements.source_quality_note: Selected original pages inspected. HFR mean profiles have differing coverage. Tidal model error strips, velocity confidence ellipses and seasonal velocity changes are separate supports. Exact width uncertainty unresolved.
remaining_gates: Recover raw radar fields, actual section averaging weights and reproducible zero-crossing boundaries.
Recover compatible dated widths before seasonal inference or geometry.

original_regional_context.display_caption: Ravenna: 40 km reported width of a mean surface-flow profile. Northern section AA-prime. Two locations do not establish a 40-50 km seasonal range. No mapped width edges.
original_regional_context.display_method_note: Observed radar mean flow, separate from tidal-model predictions. Deployment spans October 2002-October 2004 with site-specific gaps; identical averaging times and weights unresolved. Effective depth, grid spacing and velocity confidence are not a width slab or width error. Seasonal velocity changes do not supply seasonal widths.
